{{short description|American mathematician}}
'''Curtis Greene''' is an American [[mathematician]], specializing in [[algebraic combinatorics]]. He is the J. McLain King Professor of Mathematics at [[Haverford College]] in [[Pennsylvania]].<ref name="hc">[http://www.haverford.edu/faculty/cgreene Faculty profile] and [http://www.haverford.edu/math/cgreene.html home page] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120413060546/http://www.haverford.edu/math/cgreene.html |date=2012-04-13 }}, Haverford College, retrieved 2012-02-20.</ref>

Greene did his undergraduate studies at [[Harvard University]], and earned his Ph.D. in 1969 from the [[California Institute of Technology]] under the supervision of [[Robert P. Dilworth]].<ref name="hc"/><ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=10410}}</ref> He held positions at the [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]] and the [[University of Pennsylvania]] before moving to Haverford.
